fun_facts: Keelon Russell is from Duncanville, Texas.
At Duncanville High School, he won two state championships.
As a senior, he earned both Gatorade National Player of the Year and Elite 11 Finals MVP honors.
One high-school season, he completed 220 of 316 passes, with 53 touchdowns and only four interceptions.
In Alabama’s 2026 season opener, Russell accounted for 335 yards and a touchdown.
